title: Grateful Dead Live at Newcastle City Hall on 1972-04-11

ai_review.summary: Soundboard release captures an energetic Europe ’72 set with a soaring Greatest Story Ever Told and standout new classics.
ai_review.review: The recording, sourced from the soundboard, is praised for its clarity and brings to life a brilliant, high‑energy performance that opened with a powerful rendition of "Greatest Story Ever Told" and introduced fresh staples such as "Tennessee Jed," "Brown Eyed Women," and a pedal‑steel‑enhanced "Looks Like Rain." Reviewers note Bob Weir’s expanded second‑guitar work and overall band tightness, making this long‑awaited release a must‑hear.

ai_rating.rationale: Single detailed 5‑star review highlights an exceptional show and implies excellent soundboard quality, leading to a high rating despite limited data.

recording_quality.technical_notes: No specific audio issues mentioned; reviewers emphasize the release’s clarity and overall brilliance.

show_quality.setlist_flow: The set opened with a high‑impact Greatest Story Ever Told and flowed smoothly into new repertoire pieces, maintaining strong momentum throughout.

band_member_comments.Bob: His second guitar parts go beyond mere rhythm, adding depth to the performance.
